title: Ladder and Portable Electrical Equipment Inspection Register
subtitle: Dralenko Kitchens Manufacturing, Hamilton factory, Bloemfontein. Register for the second quarter of 2026

rows: Hamilton factory, 14 Kiewiet Street, Hamilton, Bloemfontein (fictitious address)
Portable ladders and step ladders; portable electrical tools and extension leads used in the workshop and assembly bays
Pieter Botha, Maintenance Supervisor, appointed in writing as the competent person for ladders and portable electrical equipment (appointment letter in Section B)
Monthly, as the company's risk assessment sets, and before first use of any new or repaired item
Naledi Mokoena, Health and Safety Officer

numbered: Every ladder and portable electrical item carries a unique number and a coloured inspection tag for the current month.
The inspector checks each item against the checklist for its type and records the result below on the day.
An item that fails is tagged **Do not use**, removed to the locked quarantine cage and recorded as an action until it is repaired or destroyed.
The Health and Safety Officer reviews the register monthly and reports open actions to the health and safety committee.

blocks.p: Every ladder and portable electrical item in use was inspected on each monthly round. The round sheets, one line per item for each round, are filed behind this register.

rows: 17 of 17; one untagged item found and removed (PE 18)

blocks.p: **Quarter summary:** three monthly rounds, on 06/04, 04/05 and 01/06/2026, each covering every ladder and portable electrical item in use: 69 inspections in all (23 items on each round), plus the reinspections after repair and before first use. Four items failed and one untagged item was found and removed; all five actions were closed, the April actions by 21/04/2026 and the June action on the day it was found. No open actions at the end of June 2026. Reported to the health and safety committee meeting of 09/07/2026.
